hotfix: Windows WeatherPanel startup crash: TypeError Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'city') at WeatherPanel.tsx
rootCause: At Windows startup the safe React weather state could be replaced by the NativeHost GET_WEATHER payload, which does not always contain location; the UI also expected feelsLike while the backend emits apparentTemperature, and old/incomplete state {available:false, stale:false} could be rendered unguarded.
fix: shared normalizeWeather canonicalizes any incoming payload: undefined/null, missing location, missing city, loading, unavailable, partial NativeHost result, old persisted state, and valid weather.
WeatherPanel renders only through the normalized contract with explicit guards (Loading / Location not configured / Weather unavailable) and never throws React.
PanelErrorBoundary wraps each panel so a non-critical panel cannot blank the entire dashboard.
apparentTemperature from NativeHost is normalized to the feelsLike field the dashboard expects.
